owner_creation.analysis: The FAIL_SITE private AtomicUsize owns a site number, initially disabled at zero, without any pager pointer or allocated payload.
owner_creation.invariant: The atomic owns a scalar site identifier only.

aliases_escapes.analysis: initialize stores a copied Site discriminant and hit reads FAIL_SITE; neither returns a reference or exposes its address to native code.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Site state cannot alias an application allocation.

callback_targets.analysis: hit compares FAIL_SITE with the selected Site and directly invokes next_trigger/write_marker; no callback address is stored.
callback_targets.invariant: Site selection does not store function addresses.

invalidation.analysis: The FAIL_SITE object has static lifetime; initialize resets its value without invalidating hit references or moving the atomic.
invalidation.invariant: Reconfiguration changes a value, never its address.

mutation_commit.analysis: initialize validates the plan and descriptor first, then publishes FAIL_SITE with Release; hit loads Acquire before reading related configuration.
mutation_commit.invariant: Publication of an enabled site follows configuration.

release_pair.analysis: The FAIL_SITE AtomicUsize requires no free or close; the trace descriptor it selects is owned separately from this numeric field.
release_pair.invariant: Releasing a trace pipe never releases the site object.

error_cleanup.analysis: A rejected plan or FD check leaves FAIL_SITE disabled; hit ignores other sites without acquiring application storage.
error_cleanup.invariant: Configuration failure leaves the selected site disabled.

signals_handoff.analysis: FAIL_SITE uses the supported lock-free atomic width; this local guarantee does not approve allocation reached from legacy handlers.
signals_handoff.invariant: This scalar is accessed atomically in hook contexts.
limitations: Initialize once before handler registration; M0-SIG-002 caller allocation/queue hazards remain open and are not cleared by this storage review.

finding_context.M0-SIG-002: Context only: this entry reviews storage ownership, not the caller/application mechanism in M0-SIG-002. That finding stays open and this clear storage disposition does not resolve or approve it.
